sources.title: Ornith 1.0 — Open-Source Agentic Coding Models
sources.snippet: Ornith 1.0 is a family of open-source large language models built by DeepReinforce AI specifically for agentic coding. Ornith 1.0 comes in four sizes — 9B Dense, 31B Dense, 35B MoE, and 397B MoE — all released under MIT license.
